title: Accounts Receivable Assistant
description:
SF Partners is working with a company based in Nottingham who are looking for a Permanent Accounts Receivable Assistant on a Full Time basis. Our client is a well-established and growing technology business based in Nottingham, providing innovative products and solutions to customers across the UK and internationally. There is hybrid working options available after successful completion of probation period.

Job Purpose

The Accounts Receivable Clerk will be responsible for the efficient management of the sales ledger, including sales order billing, cash posting, account allocation, credit control and debt collection.
The role will support effective credit risk management, maintain accurate customer records and provide timely debt reporting to support financial stability.
The successful candidate will contribute to the month-end process by ensuring accurate and timely processing of transactions in line with VAT, tax and company requirements, while working collaboratively with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and support the wider finance team.

Role Responsibilities:

1. Managing a ledger of customer accounts ensuring contact details and billing information is accurate. Set up and maintain customer accounts checking sanctions, credit limits and payment terms match to business needs.
2. Complete credit control duties, including issuing statements, sending reminder emails and working with the customer via phone and email to recover debt.
3. Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, unidentified receipts, short payments and account queries.
4. Liaise with sales, customer experience, logistics and finance colleagues to resolve queries and disputed transactions to support a positive experience for our customers.
5. Perform customer credit checks related to new customer credit applications, one off credit limit increases and annual credit check; ensuring to obtain relevant approval as per our group delegation of authority.
6. Provide monthly aged debt review, provide weekly updates to the Financial Controller on customer accounts with aged debt, including highlighting high-risk accounts, actions being taken to recover debt advise of support required to resolve issues and managing the referral of bad debt to solicitors.
7. Support weekly the sales teams to understand and support action needed against the regional aged debt report.
8. Complete billing of sales orders daily, uploading invoices to relevant customer portals where necessary.
9. Complete daily cash posting against the relevant customer as per remittance advice received. Investigate and resolve unallocated cash as per remittance advice received to ensure the ledger is kept up to date.
10. Be the AR process owner, review systems and processes to make recommendations, improvements where necessary to Financial Controller.
11. Provide financial analysis and support as required.
12. Work on projects as identified by the Financial Controller.

Skills and Experience Required:
- Previous experience in a Credit Control or Accounts Receivable role.
- Excellent communication skills, with confidence dealing with customers and colleagues at all levels.
- Excellent PC skills, including outlook and teams experience.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including the ability to analyse and organise financial data utilising basic excel functions including lookup formulas, pivot tables and filters.
- Netsuite/Oracle experience, including processing of transactions, reporting and maintain customer records.
- Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a fast-moving team.
- A commercially focused, proactive and solutions-oriented approach

If you are looking for a new and exciting position in the local area, please apply for immediate consideration.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper Permanent Part time 20 - 25hrs Fully onsite

Location: Nottingham

Salary: 15.00 - 19.00 per hour, depending on experience

Hours: 20 - 25 hours per week

Working arrangement: Fully office-based, with free parking

Astute Recruitment is working with a small, established business in the Nottingham area to recruit an experienced Part-Time Bookkeeper. This is a varied, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping, maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the smooth running of a business.

Working closely with the business owner, you will manage a range of finance responsibilities, from reconciliations and invoice processing through to credit control, VAT and financial reporting. There will also be opportunities to improve existing processes and make the day-to-day finance function more efficient. The role offers flexibility across three weekdays, with the initial three-month contract offering potential for extension or a longer-term opportunity.

Key responsibilities:
- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping using Sage Cloud and Xero.
- Maintain accurate nominal ledger coding and process journal entries.
- Complete bank, card and relevant control account reconciliations.
- Process sales and purchase invoices, allocate customer receipts and record supplier payments.
- Check supplier invoices, pricing discrepancies, credit notes and additional charges.
- Support VAT returns, including appropriate VAT treatments and domestic reverse-charge requirements.
- Monitor aged debt, issue customer statements and chase overdue payments.
- Reconcile supplier statements and assist with payment-run preparation.
- Prepare financial information, including profit and loss figures, aged balances, cash-flow information and management reports.
- Support payroll administration, staff expenses and year-end preparation where required.
- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
- Identify opportunities to improve bookkeeping processes, reporting and financial controls.

About you:

We are looking for someone with strong practical bookkeeping experience who can work independently and manage their workload with accuracy and confidence.

You will ideally have:
- Proven hands-on bookkeeping experience.
- Practical experience using both Sage Cloud and Xero.
- A good understanding of nominal ledger coding, journals and bank reconciliations.
- Experience processing invoices and managing customer and supplier accounts.
- Knowledge of VAT, including the ability to identify relevant VAT treatments.
- Confident Microsoft Excel skills and good general IT ability.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation and communication skills.
- A proactive approach and the ability to take ownership of day-to-day responsibilities.

Experience with payroll, pensions, management reporting, year-end preparation or improving financial processes would be advantageous.

Other roles you may have applied for: Bookkeeper, Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Accounts Administrator.

title: Credit Control
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Credit Controller

Long Eaton £26,000-£28,000 Permanent Full Time Office-Based

Macildowie are working with this client based in Long Eaton to recruit an experienced Credit Controller into a busy finance team within a well-established organisation operating in the materials handling and equipment sector.

This is a great opportunity for a commercially minded Credit Controller who enjoys taking ownership of customer accounts, resolving disputes and building strong relationships while ensuring outstanding debt is collected effectively.

The environment is particularly well suited to someone who has worked within equipment hire, vehicle rental, construction, logistics, engineering or another asset-based business where credit control involves more than simply chasing overdue invoices.

The Role

Reporting into the Credit Control Manager, you'll take responsibility for managing B2 B customer accounts and ensuring outstanding balances are collected in line with agreed payment terms.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Proactively chasing outstanding B2 B debt by telephone and email.
- Managing your own portfolio of customer accounts.
- Investigating and resolving invoice and payment disputes.
- Handling queries relating to hire agreements, damage charges, breakdowns and other contractual costs.
- Building effective relationships with customers while maintaining a firm approach to debt collection.
- Working closely with operational and commercial teams to resolve account queries.
- Monitoring aged debt and prioritising accounts requiring action.
- Agreeing and following up payment commitments.
- Maintaining accurate customer account and collection records.
- Escalating complex or higher-risk accounts where appropriate.

About You

We're looking for an experienced Credit Controller who is confident managing commercially driven B2 B accounts.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous B2 B Credit Control experience.
- Experience within equipment or plant hire, vehicle rental, construction, logistics, engineering or a similar commercial environment.
- Confidence handling disputes and challenging customer conversations.
- Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to remain professional and commercially focused when dealing with difficult or complex accounts.
- Good organisation and attention to detail.
- A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership of your ledger.

Experience of credit control within a rental or asset-based environment would be particularly advantageous.

What's on Offer?
- £26,000-£28,000 basic salary, depending on experience.
- Permanent, full-time position.
- Fully office-based in Long Eaton.
- Monday to Friday working pattern.
- Typical hours of either 8:30am-4:30pm or 9:00am-5:00pm, depending on team coverage.
- The opportunity to join an established business in a varied, commercially focused Credit Control role.

Interested?

If you're an experienced B2 B Credit Controller looking for a permanent opportunity in the Long Eaton area, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Macildowie for a confidential discussion.

title: Finance & Billing Co-Ordinator
description:
Our client, a manufacturing business in Colwick, is looking for a temp to perm candidate to start ASAP in a finance and billing role. This is office based.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Industrial / Manufacturing sector in Colwick and is very well established. This is an office based role with a 40 hour working week.

Description
- Process billing information accurately to help ensure invoices are raised correctly and on time.
- Maintain clear finance records so that information is easy to review and use.
- Check billing details and resolve basic discrepancies to reduce delays in processing.
- Update relevant finance systems with accurate information to support reliable records.
- Prepare routine billing and finance information for internal use.
- Organise documents and records to keep finance administration orderly and accessible.
- Work with colleagues to gather the information needed to complete billing activities.
- Handle day-to-day finance and billing queries in a timely, professional manner.

Profile

A successful 'Finance & Billing Co-Ordinator' should have:
- Experience of finance administration and billing work.
- Ability to process information accurately and maintain clear records.
- Confidence checking billing details and identifying discrepancies.
- Ability to manage routine tasks and meet agreed deadlines.
- Clear written and verbal communication for handling finance queries.
- Ability to organise documents and work carefully with detailed information.

Job Offer
- Hours 8.30-5 or 9-5.30.
- Annual salary of £28-30k
- Based in Colwick.
- Fully office based.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Accounts Receivable Analyst

Nottingham (Hybrid)

6 Month Fixed Term Contract (with the potential of becoming permanent)

£26,000-£28,000

Recent graduate with some accounts admin under your belt? Or a Finance Assistant ready for your next step? This one's for you.

You'll join a large, high-growth business in the heart of Nottingham, and a genuinely supportive, collaborative team that will back you from day one. It's a 6 month fixed term contract, with potential to turn permanent.

What you'll do

- Own customer billing enquiries and see them through to resolution

title: Interim Credit Controller

title: Part Time Payroll Administrator
description:
As a Part Time Payroll Administrator in Newark, you will manage / support payroll activities and payroll administration.

You will work as part of the Accounting & Finance department in a permanent role with hybrid working available for a brilliant team.

Client Details

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing business in their Payroll department.

Our client is looking for someone on a permanent and Part Time basis to support in their payroll team.

This role is offering hybrid working in Newark with part time hours available.

If you have experience in finance (Transactional finance) but not in payroll but looking for part time hybrid opportunities, you are encouraged to apply as Payroll experience is not essential.

Description
- Manage day-to-day payroll activities to support accurate and timely pay processing.
- Maintain payroll information and records within the Accounting & Finance department.
- Review payroll data and resolve discrepancies to keep information accurate.
- Prepare payroll information for processing and ensure key deadlines are met.
- Respond to payroll-related queries and provide clear updates where needed.
- Work with relevant internal teams to gather accurate payroll information.
- Keep payroll documentation organised and up to date.

Profile

A successful Part Time Payroll Administrator should have:
- Experience of working in a finance role.
- Experience in Payroll is advantageous.
- Experience with Excel.
- Confidence maintaining payroll records and checking data for accuracy.
- Ability to investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies.
- Experience handling payroll queries in a clear and helpful way.
- Good organisation when managing documentation and routine payroll tasks.
- Ability to work effectively within an Accounting & Finance team.

Job Offer
- Permanent, part-time Part Time Payroll Administrator position.
- Salary of 28,000 to 33000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Hybrid working.
- Based in Newark.
- Additional benefits to be confirmed.

title: Payroll & People Administrator - P/T
description:
The Payroll Administrator is fully accountable for the accurate, timely and compliant delivery of payroll for KDB UK employees. The role manages all payroll activities from data collection and validation through to payroll processing, statutory reporting, reconciliations and employee support, ensuring employees are paid correctly and on time.

Working closely with Finance, People & Communications and external payroll providers, the Payroll Administrator maintains payroll records, ensures compliance with UK legislation and supports continuous improvement of payroll processes.

This is a Part-Time (22-28 hours per week) position, we can be flexible on start and finish times.

KDB - Kone Doors Business

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Management
- Take full ownership of the monthly payroll process for approximately 70 UK employees.
- Prepare, validate and submit payroll data accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Manage all payroll-related changes, including:
- New starters, Leavers, Salary changes, Bonuses and commissions, Overtime payments, Pension contributions, Statutory payments, Deductions and benefits
- Review payroll reports and undertake pre-payroll checks to ensure accuracy.
- Ensure benefits are correctly implemented

Compliance & Governance
- Ensure payroll activities comply with UK legislation, HMRC requirements and company policies and maintain accurate payroll records and audit trails.
- Manage submissions relating to PAYE, National Insurance, pensions and other statutory obligations and support year-end payroll activities, including P60s and other statutory reporting requirements.

Employee Support
- Act as the primary point of contact for payroll queries and provide timely and professional support to employees and managers regarding pay, deductions, pensions and payroll processes.
- Resolve payroll issues efficiently and confidentially.

Finance & Reporting
- Reconcile payroll reports with finance records.
- Support monthly payroll journals and reporting requirements.
- Produce payroll-related reports and analysis as required.
- Assist with payroll audits and internal controls.

Systems & Process Improvement
- Maintain payroll data integrity across HR and payroll systems.
- Identify opportunities to improve payroll accuracy, efficiency and compliance.
- Support payroll system updates, testing and process documentation.

Other Administration
- Support the Fleet Management administration alongside the external supplier
- Ownership of parking management for engineers
- Supporting People & Communications team with onboarding and offboarding
- Manage vetting processes for employees
- Support in the administration for corporate phone supplier
- General admin support of the P&C Business Partner

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Essential
- Proven payroll administration experience with end-to-end payroll accountability, and strong knowledge of UK payroll legislation and HMRC requirements
- Experience managing payroll through an outsourced payroll provider
- Knowledge of pension administration and benefits processing
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy, together with strong Excel and payroll systems skills
- Ability to manage confidential information with discretion
- Strong organisational and time management skills

Desirable - CIPP qualification or equivalent payroll certification and experience in a standalone payroll role

What KDB can offer:

We offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday and 8 additional Bank Holidays, 1 volunteering day, Pension Scheme, Development opportunities and development reviews to help you achieve your professional goals. Endless support from experienced leaders within the doors industry, Bonus, Dental Insurance, Medical Insurance, GymFlex Membership, Life Assurance, Cycle to Work Scheme, Long Service Awards, Kone Discounts, 24/7 GP Support & Wellbeing Access and hybrid working.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk Mansfield 26,000 Permanent Full onsite

Astute Recruitment are working with a well-established business based in Mansfield who are looking to recruit an organised and detail-oriented Purchase Ledger Clerk to join their finance team on a permanent basis.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous purchase ledger experience who enjoys working in a busy finance environment and takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records.

The Role:

Working as part of the finance team, your responsibilities will include:
- Scanning and processing incoming purchase invoices and delivery tickets accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Registering purchase invoices onto the system, ensuring all information is correctly recorded.
- Matching invoices against delivery tickets and purchase orders, investigating and resolving any discrepancies.
- Forwarding unmatched invoices for internal approval and following up where necessary.
- Carrying out regular supplier statement reconciliations to ensure all invoices and credit notes are accounted for.
- Handling purchase ledger queries via email and telephone, liaising with suppliers and internal departments.
- Maintaining accurate and organised filing systems for invoices, delivery tickets and supplier statements.

About You:

We are looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience working within a purchase ledger or similar finance role.
- Good IT and numeracy skills, with strong Microsoft Office experience, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Excellent organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail.
- The ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to work independently, manage their own workload and meet deadlines.
- A flexible approach and willingness to support the wider finance team as priorities change.
- Experience working within a busy, fast-paced environment.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Assistant
Location: Newark
Contract: Fixed-term contract - approximately 9 months
Working arrangements: Hybrid working - 2 days in the office
SF Partners are recruiting for an experienced Purchase Ledger Assistant to join a long-standing business based in Newark.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied, fast-paced purchase ledger role, with responsibility for managing their own portfolio of sites and overseeing the process from purchase order through to payment.
Working as part of an established finance team, you will take ownership of multiple ledgers, build strong relationships with Site Managers and ensure the smooth running of the purchase ledger function.
The role will include:
- Processing high volumes of purchase invoices accurately using Sage 50.
- Taking ownership of your own portfolio of UK sites, managing the purchase ledger from purchase order through to payment.
- Managing supplier accounts, reviewing aged creditor reports and proactively resolving outstanding queries.
- Preparing and raising payment runs at mid-month and month-end.
- Completing bank reconciliations and monitoring company accounts.
- Working closely with Site Managers to confirm receipt of goods and maintain an accurate, up-to-date purchase order system.
- Building relationships with internal stakeholders and handling supplier and internal queries.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end and year-end activities.
- Supporting the wider finance team with reporting, reconciliations and general accounts administration.

About you:
- Previous experience in a busy purchase ledger/accounts payable role is essential.
- Confident using Sage 50 or a similar accounting system.
- Good understanding of the full purchase ledger process, including purchase orders, invoice processing, supplier reconciliations and payment runs.
- Comfortable managing multiple ledgers and handling high volumes of work.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and manage your own workload.
- Confident building relationships and communicating with suppliers, Site Managers and wider internal teams.
- Proactive, methodical and able to work independently, whilst contributing to a busy team environment.

This role would suit an experienced Purchase Ledger Assistant who enjoys having responsibility, can hit the ground running and is confident managing a varied workload across multiple sites. An immediate or short-notice start would be advantageous, with the opportunity to join ahead of the current postholder's maternity leave.
If you have the relevant experience and are interested in finding out more, please get in touch!

title: Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
I am recruiting for a Sales Ledger Clerk to join an established engineering business based in Worksop. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented finance professional to join a busy team within a business that offers exposure to a varied range of commercial and operational activities. The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting cash flow and creating strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.

About the Role

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing the day-to-day sales ledger, ensuring customer accounts are accurate and up to date.
- Raising and processing sales invoices and credit notes in a timely and accurate manner.
- Allocating customer payments and monitoring outstanding balances.
- Proactively chasing overdue invoices and supporting effective credit control.
- Handling customer account queries and resolving invoice or payment discrepancies.
- Reconciling customer accounts and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Liaising with colleagues across finance, sales and operations to resolve queries and ensure efficient processes.
- Supporting wider finance activities and taking on additional responsibilities as experience develops.

Skills and Experience Required
- Previous experience in a sales ledger, accounts receivable or credit control role.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Confident communication skills and a professional approach to customer queries and payment chasing.
- Experience using Microsoft Excel and accounting or ERP systems.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a wider team.
- A proactive attitude, willingness to learn and an interest in developing within finance.
- Experience within an engineering, manufacturing or project-based environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

Why Is This a Great Opportunity?
- Career progression: The opportunity to develop your existing finance experience and take on greater responsibility as your skills develop.
- Wider business exposure: Gain insight into the commercial and operational functions of an established engineering business.
- Professional development: Broaden your knowledge of finance processes, credit control and financial reporting.
- Cross-functional working: Build relationships with colleagues across finance, sales and operations, developing a stronger understanding of how the business works.
- Varied responsibilities: Develop beyond routine sales ledger processing and gain experience across different aspects of the finance function.
- Long-term potential: Join a business where you can contribute, develop professionally and work towards the next stage of your finance career.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.
